details:
=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/ai_memory_lib.py:_inject_token_into_url (lines 3040-3052), _resolve_origin_url (lines 3077-3084) | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: _resolve_origin_url embeds GH_TOKEN into HTTPS clone URLs instead of using per-process http.extraHeader authentication.
  WHY: The token appears in process arguments, git remote get-url output, Git diagnostics, and cloned .git/config, violating the credential-isolation contract and failing the git-auth hygiene test.

- scripts/memory_helpers.sh:_memory_force_tick_remote_url (line 585) | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: _memory_force_tick_remote_url embeds GH_PAT/GH_TOKEN in the HTTPS remote URL.
  WHY: The credential becomes visible in process arguments, Git diagnostics, remote configuration, and recorded URLs.

- scripts/targeted_file_context.py:normalize_path (lines 240-247) and emit_context path loop (~lines 536-620) | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: Sensitive-path rejection and MAX_TARGET_PATHS/MAX_TARGET_PATH_BYTES were deleted.
  WHY: Issue- or plan-derived paths can inline .git/config, .env, .ssh, .aws, and other credential-bearing files into model prompts and transcripts.

- scripts/implement_diagnose_post_codex_failure.sh:line 668 (--sandbox danger-full-access) | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: Diagnose bypasses the model-provider broker and runs Codex with danger-full-access while GH_TOKEN and OPENROUTER_API_KEY remain in the environment.
  WHY: Issue-derived captured failure content can prompt Codex to read credentials or mutate the workspace outside the brokered isolation boundary.

- scripts/codex_helpers.sh:file now ends at line ~140 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: The model_provider_broker_* shell API was deleted while workflows and scripts still invoke it.
  WHY: Model-facing phases fail with command not found before Codex starts, and the credential-isolation boundary is removed.

- scripts/codex_stall_guard.sh:argument parser (lines 49-54) | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: --process-group-file and its process-group metadata wiring were removed while scripts/review_apply_fixes.sh:553 still passes the option.
  WHY: Isolated editor launches exit with unknown option before the editor runs and cannot verify process-group cleanup.

- scripts/codex_stall_guard.sh:_kill_child_group_if_running (lines ~287-303) | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: Isolated-user process-group metadata, privileged cleanup, and survivor verification were removed.
  WHY: os.killpg can raise PermissionError against nobody-owned descendants, leaving workspace-accessing editor processes alive.

- scripts/write_codex_config.sh:argument parser (lines 95-112) and hardcoded base_url at line 258 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: --provider-base-url was removed and the provider URL was hardcoded to https://openrouter.ai/api/v1.
  WHY: Existing callers fail with unknown argument errors, while surviving callers cannot target the loopback broker.

- scripts/gh_helpers.sh:deleted git_with_github_auth (was ~line 493) and review_blocked_* family (was ~lines 947-1352) | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: Shared authenticated-git and review-blocked approval helper APIs were removed while live callers remain.
  WHY: Judge-fix pushes fail with command not found and review-blocked approval, merge, or reissue decisions cannot complete.

- scripts/gh_helpers.sh:_gh_pr_with_all_comments_rest (lines 766-772) and GraphQL comment transform (lines ~833-924) | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: Normalized comment payloads drop id, author_id, author_type, and author_association.
  WHY: Review-blocked approval verification cannot bind producer comments or validate human approvers.

- scripts/memory_helpers.sh:_memory_git removed at the prior ~line 596; bare git calls at lines 151, 180, 601, 624, 767, 883, 919 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, moonshotai_kimi-k3, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: Bare git operations replaced _memory_git while workflow checkouts use persist-credentials: false.
  WHY: ai-memory branch initialization and force-tick clone/push operations run against an unauthenticated HTTPS origin and fail silently.

- .github/workflows/issue_pr_status.yml:"Configure git auth for memory helper clones" lines 68-82 versus "Fetch memory helper scripts" lines 88+ | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3, moonshotai_kimi-k3, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: GIT_CONFIG_COUNT/GIT_CONFIG_KEY_0/GIT_CONFIG_VALUE_0 are exported only in one shell step and are unavailable to later memory operations.
  WHY: With persist-credentials: false on both checkouts, subsequent memory Git calls have no authentication and ai-memory initialization degrades silently.

- scripts/implement_commit_changes.sh:staged-support restore block (lines 98-237) | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: The restore block depends on STAGED_SUPPORT_LEDGER and STAGED_SUPPORT_BASE_DIR, but no workflow or staging script exports them.
  WHY: The protection never activates, so immutable support-ref copies can overwrite branch-owned helper changes.

- scripts/implement_commit_changes.sh:git merge-file invocation at line ~204 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus]
  PROBLEM: The three-way merge is reported to pass the editor, support baseline, and HEAD files in the wrong roles.
  WHY: Reviewers report that the incorrect common ancestor can silently drop branch-owned changes; moonshotai_kimi-k3 explicitly verified this claim as incorrect and emitted no finding.

- tests/test_targeted_file_context.py:lines 30 and 37 (imports of MAX_TARGET_PATHS and is_sensitive_target_path) | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: The test module imports MAX_TARGET_PATHS and is_sensitive_target_path, both deleted from scripts/targeted_file_context.py.
  WHY: Pytest collection raises ImportError and the targeted-file-context CI gate fails before tests run.

- scripts/implement_diagnose_post_codex_failure.sh:patch_diagnose_reasoning_into_config line ~101 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: The reasoning patch writes to ${HOME:-/root}/.codex/config.toml instead of the CODEX_HOME-selected config path.
  WHY: Broker-prepared Codex runs may read a different config, so the intended reasoning setting is silently ignored.

- scripts/implement_handle_guard_block.sh:staged-support rejection block (lines 14-70) | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: Best-effort label/comment operations can fail while the handler exits or reports a latch state inconsistently.
  WHY: API failures can leave workflow state divergent from the escalation comment or cause redispatch behavior; moonshotai_kimi-k3 did not adopt this claim.

- scripts/targeted_file_context.py:emit_context lines 536-716 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3, moonshotai_kimi-k3, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: Marker, header, summary, and fallback content accounting no longer consistently advances used_bytes, and the path-count cap was removed.
  WHY: An untrusted path list can exceed TARGETED_FILE_CONTEXT_MAX_BYTES and the Codex stdin cap.

- agents.md:"## Model credential isolation" section; README.md MODEL_PROVIDER_BROKER_MAX_* rows | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: Documentation still describes the deleted model-provider broker as the active credential-isolation boundary.
  WHY: Operators are directed to a lifecycle and limits that no longer have working callers or enforcement.

=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===
- requirement: The linked issue #4092 scopes the work to three defect classes: immutable issue_pr_status.yml helper resolution, reviewed full-SHA pins for astral-sh/setup-uv, and reviewed full-SHA pins for jlumbroso/free-disk-space; fix every instance and implement each mitigation as an automated, deterministic control.
  expected_change_site: scripts/codex_helpers.sh, scripts/codex_stall_guard.sh, scripts/gh_helpers.sh, scripts/write_codex_config.sh, scripts/ai_memory_lib.py, scripts/memory_helpers.sh, scripts/targeted_file_context.py, scripts/implement_diagnose_post_codex_failure.sh
  confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus]
  EVIDENCE: The diff deletes model_provider_broker_*, --process-group-file, review_blocked_* and git_with_github_auth, --provider-base-url, per-process git authentication, sensitive-path and path-count protections, and brokered diagnose execution; none of these files or deletions belong to the linked issue's three requested defect classes.
